name: Photo Album

pages.text: Open the album and arrange printed photos; signing closes further editing.

pages.title: Filling
pages.text: Craft through JEI and use the album to open its native editor. Arrange printed photographs rather than raw film. Page order and captions are set in the album itself.

pages.title: Signing
pages.text: Check page order and text before signing. A signed album is a separate state that no longer supports the same editing. Use a separate paper print for a frame.

jem_summary: Open the album and arrange printed photos; signing closes further editing.
